open MeasureTheory
open scoped InnerProductSpace ENNReal
definition_context: E and H are real inner-product spaces. E is finite-dimensional with its Borel measurable structure, and H is complete. E →L[ℝ] H denotes continuous real linear maps; D(w).adjoint denotes the Hilbert adjoint.

HasFDerivAt F (D w) w and HasGradientAt f g w mean genuine ambient Fréchet derivative and gradient at w, not totalized fallback values. The integral is the Bochner integral, with the explicit Integrable claim in the conclusion.

IsProbabilityMeasure μ asserts unit total mass. anonymous_constant_1 takes a nonnegative extended cost on pairs and two measures; it is the infimum of the extended integrals of that cost over measures with the two prescribed coordinate marginals. An empty feasible set has infimum ∞.

Real.arccos is real inverse cosine. ENNReal.ofReal maps reals into [0,∞], clipping negative inputs to zero. A real exponent 1/2 is the square root here. ENNReal.toReal agrees with the finite value and sends ∞ to zero; it does not certify finiteness.
cases.statement:
example
    {E H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (F : E → H) (D : E → E →L[ℝ] H)
    (hF : ∀ w, HasFDerivAt F (D w) w)
    (M₁ M₂ : ℝ) (hM₁ : 0 ≤ M₁) (hM₂ : 0 ≤ M₂)
    (hBound : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ‖D w‖ ≤ M₁)
    (hLip : ∀ w u : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ‖D w-D u‖ ≤ M₂*‖w-u‖)
    (y : H) :
    let S := {w : E // ‖w‖ = 1}
    let K : S → H := fun w => F w.1
    let c : S × S → ℝ := fun z => Real.arccos ⟪z.1.1,z.2.1⟫_ℝ
    let m : Measure S → H := fun μ => ∫ w, K w ∂μ
    let V : Measure S → E → ℝ := fun μ w => 2 * ⟪m μ-y,F w⟫_ℝ
    let G : Measure S → E → E := fun μ w =>
      (2 : ℝ) • ((D w).adjoint (m μ-y) - ⟪(D w).adjoint (m μ-y),w⟫_ℝ • w)
    let Q : Measure S → Measure S → ℝ≥0∞ := fun μ ν =>
      anonymous_constant_1
        (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal ((c z)^2)) μ ν
    ∃ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 < C₁ ∧ 0 < C₂ ∧
      (∀ μ : Measure S, IsProbabilityMeasure μ →
        Integrable K μ ∧
        (∀ w : E, HasGradientAt (V μ) ((2 : ℝ) • (D w).adjoint (m μ-y)) w) ∧
        ∀ w : S, ⟪w.1,G μ w.1⟫_ℝ = 0 ∧ ‖G μ w.1‖ ≤ C₁) ∧
      ∀ μ ν : Measure S, IsProbabilityMeasure μ → IsProbabilityMeasure ν →
        Q μ ν ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ w u : S,
          ‖G μ w.1-G ν u.1‖ ≤
            C₂ * ((Q μ ν ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)).toReal + c (w,u))
